# اِنْتَفَعْتَ (intafaʕta) /in.ta.faʕ.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِنْتَفَعَ (intafaʕa)
# اِنْتَفَعْتِ (intafaʕti) /in.ta.faʕ.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِنْتَفَعَ (intafaʕa)
# اِنْتَفَعَتْ (intafaʕat) /in.ta.fa.ʕat/: third-perso
